faqs.q: What is the Isolated Patients Travel and Accommodation Assistance Scheme (IPTAAS)?
faqs.a: IPTAAS helps with the costs of travel and accommodation for patients who are isolated and need to travel to NSW for medical treatment.

faqs.q: How do I apply for IPTAAS?
faqs.a: You can register online for IPTAAS or lodge a travel application online.

faqs.q: What types of costs can IPTAAS help with?
faqs.a: IPTAAS can help with travel and accommodation costs incurred when travelling to NSW for medical treatment.
